summary.text: Stephen Wright is a Republican candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A real estate investor and U.S. Air Force veteran, he finished second in the August 18 primary.

paragraphs.text: Stephen Wright was born in Anchorage and has served in the U.S. Air Force.

He earned a degree in avionics systems technology from the Community College of the Air Force in 1997, dual bachelor's degrees in accounting and management from Park University in 1998, and a master's degree in business administration from Wayland Baptist University in 2004.
His listed profession is real estate investor.
In the primary, Wright received 32.8 percent of the vote, behind incumbent Elexie Moore at 33.8 percent.
